If I could change the world in one way, I would make it so that every person has access to clean, renewable energy, and that the global energy infrastructure is entirely decarbonized. This would involve a rapid transition to 100% renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind power, and the development of advanced technologies to store and distribute energy efficiently.

I believe this change would have a profound impact on the world, mitigating climate change, improving air and water quality, and enhancing energy security and equity. It would also create new economic opportunities and jobs in the renewable energy sector, driving innovation and growth.

Ultimately, a world powered by clean energy would be a more sustainable, equitable, and prosperous place for all.
